newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's trade deficit fell 16.9 pct in Jan-Nov.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's trade deficit fell 16.9 pct in Jan-Nov.

text.p: Colombia's trade deficit fell by 16.9 percent during the first 11 months of 1996 to a total of $2.1 billion, the National Statistics Department (DANE) said.
It said exports grew by 4 percent in the January-November, to a total of $9.6 billion, while imports grew by just three percent and totalled $12.5 billion.
The leading recipients of Colombian exports were the United States, Europe and members of the so-called Andean Group of countries, DANE said.
